required_record_conditions: official_sense_id nonempty OR authorized registered KU_ANCHORED_SENSE binding

findings.detail: No render_kind/question/response/correct_answer/acceptable_answers in any of 200 content-enrichment rows; cannot claim an evaluable cloze or recognition task from these files alone.
official_sense_id absent/non-populated for all 200; no authorized registered KU_ANCHORED_SENSE binding fields.
No per-row source attribution or source rights assertion; release-level rights and official membership also remain unverified.

recommendations: Keep records as display-only provisional enrichment; do not infer correct answers or automatic scoring.
Build isolated render-kind/response contract candidates with source-anchored KU identity, variants and discriminative distractors, then independently QA.
Obtain verified official sense binding, attribution/rights and independent semantic approvals before release.
interpretation: Absence of fields in this batch does not prove the wider application lacks a separate renderer; this audit is confined to the 12 teaching content part files and examined release gate.
